newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks closes up on Dow, weekend buyers.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks closes up on Dow, weekend buyers.

text.p: Mexican stocks closed just shy of 3,400 points Friday in a rally inspired by gains on Wall Street and as foreign dealers invested over the weekend in Mexican stocks that trade in New York.
"The advance in the Dow Jones (industrial average) and heavier trading in ADRs (American Depository Receipts) were what buoyed up the bourse," a dealer said.
"I think today's gains were mostly speculative. Although dealing was light, we noticed some foreigners buying on a weekend trip down here."
The blue chip IPC index closed up 37.49 points, or 1.116 percent, at 3,396.95. In the broader market, 91 stocks changed hands, of which 54 advanced while 20 declined.
Volume was heavy at 196.1 million shares traded, but this figure was inflated by 149 million shares of telephone company Telmex that changed hands in just one cross trade.
Analysts said the deal could have been a repurchase of stock to increase the company's reserves.
In New York, the Dow index jumped 101.60 points, or 1.6 percent, to close at 6,544.09.
Among Mexican companies that trade in New York, market heavyweight Telmex edged up 1/4 to 33-3/8, while media group Televisa ended up 1/2 at 25-5/8.
Telmex "A" series and Televisa "CPO" shares gained four centavos (1 cent) and 1.90 pesos (24 cents), respectively, to 13.04 ($1.66) and 100.80 pesos ($12.82).
Retail company Ceramic "UB" series led the gainers, up 50 centavos (6 cents) to 10.00 pesos ($1.27), but at relatively light trade, dealers noted.
Construction firm Tribasa was another notable leader, up 84 centavos ($10.68) at 19.64 pesos ($2.50).
"Tribasa stock had been hit hard and bargain-hunters snapped it up," a dealer said.
Construction firm Bufete headed the sliders, off 3.70 pesos (47 cents) to 51.40 pesos ($6.54), but at relatively thin trade.
Traders said they expected volume to recover next week as vacationers return to work, paving the way for the IPC to attempt to break through the pyschological barrier of 3,400 points.
